verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents exporting scan results to SARIF, an open format, and generating SBOMs of open source components. Its AppSec Platform API can gather findings, and a hands-on user built tooling on the SARIF output. There is no documented whole-account export covering triage state, tickets, settings or private rules as a path to leave the platform. Missing for 10: documented complete export of all platform data, an explicit migration/offboarding path, and open-format export of platform triage history and private rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: To export the results to a SARIF file: semgrep ci --sarif --sarif-output=semgrep.sarif
Generate reports and software bills of materials (SBOM) that provide a complete inventory of your open source components
Semgrep AppSec Platform provides an API that enables you to list deployments, gather findings created by Semgrep AppSec Platform, and list projects.
Built a tool using Semgrep's SARIF output plus prompted LLMs to help prioritize triage
